I don't know why.''"
"''It's because Oplock forgave me. He judges me on the person I am. Unlike you, Oplock decided to help me through things.|Jarek Yeager and Marcus Speedstar, about Oplock|audio=OplockHelped-ThePlatformClassic.flac|}} '''Oplock''' was an [[Esral'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender|male]] [[Technician|mechanic]] who worked as part of the [[racer]] [[Marcus Speedstar]]'s [[Marcus Speedstar's racing team|team]] alongside the [[astromech droid]] [[R4-D12]]. Around [[20 ABY]], when Speedstar's racing tactics resulted in the [[death]]s of his brother [[Jarek Yeager]]'s [[Yeager family|family]] in a [[Sky race|racing]] accident, Oplock decided to forgive his employer for the incident and continue working with him. For the next several [[Standard year|years]], the [[Nikto|Esral'sa'Nikto]] remained loyal to his employer and forged a deep friendship with him. At some point, Speedstar incurred heavy debts to the [[Guavian Death Gang]], resulting in him fleeing an encounter with the group's [[Guavian security soldier|soldiers]] with Oplock on the [[planet]] [[Rishi]]. In [[34 ABY]], Oplock accompanied Speedstar to the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' on the planet [[Castilon]] to participate in the [[Platform Classic]] race. While aboard, he visited [[Jarek Yeager's Repair Station]] with the [[pilot]] and greeted Yeager's employees, [[Neeku Vozo]], [[Tamara Ryvora]], and [[Kazuda Xiono]]. Afterward, the pair enjoyed beverages in the ''Colossus''{{'s}} [[Aunt Z's Tavern]] in a booth. However, a [[Unidentified Guavian security soldier 1|pair]] [[Unidentified Guavian security soldier 2|of]] Guavian [[soldier]]s entered the [[cantina]] and took Oplock hostage until Speedstar repaid his debts to them. Shortly afterward, after eventually convincing Yeager to let him pull ahead in the race, Speedstar won the Platform Classic and used its prize [[Currency|money]] to free Oplock. ==Biography== ===Loyal companion=== [[File:MarcusSpeedstar-ThePlatformClassic.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Oplock joined Marcus Speedstar's crew during the time of the New Republic.]] The [[Esral'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender|male]] Oplock was a [[Technician|mechanic]] who lived during the [[New Republic Era]]. At some point, Oplock joined the [[racer]] [[Marcus Speedstar]]'s [[Marcus Speedstar's racing team|team]] and became the [[pilot]]'s trusted and loyal friend. Around [[20 ABY]],{{EncyclopediaCite|Ace Squadron}} dates the [[death]]s of [[Jarek Yeager]]'s [[Jarek Yeager's wife|wife]] and [[Jarek Yeager's daughter|daughter]] to roughly two [[Standard decade|decades]] after the [[Battle of Yavin]], equating to around [[20 ABY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. Speedstar participated in a [[Sky race|race]] against his brother, [[Jarek Yeager]], and used a large amount of [[Coaxium|hyperfuel]] in his [[Starship|ship]] to gain an unfair advantage. As a result, Speedstar's ship combusted and crashed into the race's viewing stands, [[Death|killing]] Yeager's [[Jarek Yeager's wife|wife]] and [[Jarek Yeager's daughter|daughter]]. Oplock forgave his employer for the mistake in the aftermath of the event. Yeager was furious with what he perceived to be Speedstar's all-consuming desire to win and gain fame, which had resulted in him using the deceptive racing tactics that had killed his [[Yeager family|family]]. As a result, while Oplock stayed with Speedstar, Yeager ceased all contact with his brother and went into relative retirement from racing. Though Speedstar initially attempted to reconnect with his brother, he eventually stopped pursuing him and continued finding comfort in Oplock's forgiveness of his actions and willingness to help him improve as a person. In the following [[Standard year|years]], the [[Nikto|Esral'sa'Nikto]] continued to serve in his employer's crew alongside the [[astromech droid]] [[R4-D12]] to help repair Speedstar's [[racing starfighter]], ''[[Galaxy's Glory]]''.{{Databank|galaxys-glory|Galaxy's Glory}} During this [[time]], Speedstar's fame continued to grow throughout [[the galaxy]] as he won more races, including becoming the three-time champion of the [[Five Sabers]], a prestigious piloting championship held on the [[planet]] [[Theron]],[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']] and participating in the [[Baktan 5000]] race. ===''Colossus'' arrival=== {{Quote|He likes us. That's a traditional Cracek greeting of friendship. My name is Neeku. This is Kaz and Tam.''"
[Oplock shrieks amicably]
"''Huh. Everyone meet Oplock and the astromech R4-D12.|Neeku Vozo and Oplock, to Kazuda Xiono and Tamara Ryvora|audio=HeLikesUs-ThePlatformClassic.flac|}} [[File:OplockVozo-ThePlatformClassic.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Oplock greeting Jarek Yeager's employees]] At some point, Speedstar lost several races and incurred heavy debts totalling 20,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to the [[Guavian Death Gang]] criminial organization''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' after taking out loans. He and Oplock attempted to avoid the organization's collectors by pulling a maneuver on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] planet''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Traveler's Guide to Batuu]]'' [[Rishi]] to avoid a ship owned by [[Guavian security soldier|Guavian soldiers]]. Afterward, Speedstar signed up for the [[Platform Classic]] race held on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] planet [[Castilon]], to both meet with Yeager again and earn much-needed [[Currency|funds]]. In [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|1|9}} Oplock traveled to the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' on Castilon with Speedstar and R4-D12 for the Platform Classic. When Speedstar visited [[Jarek Yeager's Repair Station|Yeager's repair shop]] on the ''Colossus'', Oplock accompanied him as he tried to apologize to his brother. As the siblings walked deeper into the shop, the Esral'sa'Nikto greeted Yeager's employees—[[Tamara Ryvora]], [[Kazuda Xiono]], and the fellow [[Kadas'sa'Nikto|Nikto]] [[Neeku Vozo]]—with a cheerful customary friendship greeting in the [[Cracek]] [[language]], his native [[tongue]]. Though Xiono and Ryvora were frightened by the Cracek greeting, Vozo clarified its meaning to them and introduced R4-D12 on Oplock's behalf while the Esral'sa'Nikto hugged him. On the other side of the repair shop, Yeager expressed his disapproval that Oplock had forgiven Speedstar, though the latter defended his friend's choice to stay loyal to him and judge him based on his current self. Shortly afterward, Oplock left Yeager's shop with his employer and R4-D12. ===Hostage situation=== {{Quote|Wha—wha—what? You're taking Oplock until I pay? Come on, boys, let's be reasonable.''"
[Oplock growls]
"''It's okay, Oplock, just go with the nice Death Gang for the next few hours. There's nothing to worry about.|Marcus Speedstar and Oplock, to two Guavian Death Gang guards|audio=TakingOplock-ThePlatformClassic.flac|}} [[File:OplockDeathGangHostage-ThePlatformClassic.png|thumb|left|300px|Oplock was taken hostage by Guavian guards until Speedstar repaid his loans.]] Oplock, Speedstar, and R4-D12 then visited [[Aunt Z's Tavern]] establishment, and the former two enjoyed beverages while sitting at a booth. When a [[Unidentified Guavian security soldier 1|pair]] [[Unidentified Guavian security soldier 2|of]] Guavian Death Gang [[soldier]]s entered the [[cantina]] looking for Speedstar, Oplock nervously clutched his drink and drank from it while sinking further into his seat. The two soldiers waved off Speedstar's excuses for the Rishi maneuver, roughly forcing the mechanic into their custody. The racer attempted to reassure Oplock that he would be free within a few [[Standard hour|hours]], after he had won the Platform Classic and used its prize money to pay off his debts. As the Death Gang enforcers escorted the Esral'sa'Nikto away, Speedstar sorrowfully watched them leave and claimed that he would win the upcoming race, as no pilot on the [[Supertanker fuel depot|station]] could compete with him. Moments after, Yeager entered Aunt Z's Tavern and announced he would compete against Speedstar in the upcoming race. Although the former had expected his brother to back down, Speedstar agreed to race his older sibling, knowing he had to win to save Oplock. Yeager was shocked, having counted on the other pilot not to agree to race him. However, he remained committed to beating Speedstar to teach him a lesson and assigned Xiono to help him prepare for the race since Oplock had been apprehended. Despite Xiono's attempts to convince Yeager that his brother needed the Platform Classic's prize money to save Oplock, the older man insisted it was not his concern. ===The Platform Classic=== {{Quote|Jarek, believe me when I say I am racing for more than myself this time. Like you used to.|Marcus Speedstar to Jarek Yeager, about the former's participation in the race to win money for Oplock's freedom|audio=RacingForMore-ThePlatformClassic.flac|}} [[File:OplockDeathGangRelease-ThePlatformClassic.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Oplock was released by the Guavian Death Gang after Speedstar paid his debts.]] Speedstar continued to plead with Yeager to listen as they began the race and later on as they flew alongside each other. Meanwhile, Oplock remained on the ''Colossus'' in the custody of two Guavian Death Gang enforcers who prodded at him with their [[weapon]]s. In the Platform Classic's final stages, Speedstar apologized to Yeager in full for his family's deaths, insisting that he was racing in this competition to save Oplock, not for a selfish reason as he would have in the past. As they approached the end of the race, Yeager relented and pulled away, allowing Speedstar to win the Platform Classic. Afterward, Speedstar used his prize money to pay the Guavian Death Gang enforcers, who allowed Oplock to walk free. Although Oplock was slightly disgruntled with how the guards had treated him, Speedstar was happy to have his trusted mechanic back. As their racing crew prepared to depart the ''Colossus'', the Esral'sa'Nikto helped carry a supply case up a ladder. Once Speedstar and Yeager had parted on amiable terms, Oplock boarded the ''Galaxy's Glory'' with his employer and left the ''Colossus''. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Oplock, it's good to have you back, buddy. They treat you okay?''"
[Oplock dispiritedly groans]|quoteend=0|Marcus Speedstar and Oplock after the latter's release from the Guavian Death Gang's custody|audio=OplockBack-ThePlatformClassic.flac|}} Oplock had [[Color|gray]] skin and black [[eye]]s. He could not speak [[Galactic Basic Standard]] but spoke Cracek and used facial expressions to show his feelings. According to Speedstar, Oplock was a forgiving person who judged him by the person that he was. Oplock stood by Speedstar when Yeager severed relations following a racing accident that claimed the lives of his [[Marriage|wife]] and daughter. Oplock expressed fear and anxiety after he was taken hostage by the Guavian Death Gang to ensure that Speedstar would pay his debts. He was elated when Speedstar won the race and was able to secure his freedom, happy to be with his friend again. ==Skills and abilities== {{Listen3|OplockGreets-ThePlatformClassic.flac|Oplock giving a traditional greeting of friendship in Cracek}} As a mechanic and part of Speedstar's racing team, he helped maintain the racer's ship, ''Galaxy's Glory''. He could speak the Cracek language. ==Equipment== While working as a mechanic, Oplock wore a gray and black [[jumpsuit]] with purple detailing on its sleeves and collar. He also donned a pair of gray and purple [[boot]]s. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Jonathan Lipow plays Oplock. He makes the most inhuman voices ever. He's the perfect person to play all these like alien sounds. He's really phenomenal.|Christopher Sean|audio=Cracek-ThePlatformClassicCommentary.flac|{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars Resistance: Complete Season One|episode=The Platform Classic}}}} [[File:Oplock-ConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Concept art of Oplock by JP Balmet]] Oplock first appeared in "[[The Platform Classic]]," the ninth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[November 25]], [[2018]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} The Esral'sa'Nikto's facial fins were designed to help him express his emotions while speaking Cracek by flaring outward.{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-the-platform-classic-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 11 Fun Facts from "The Platform Classic" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}} [[Lucasfilm Animation]] artist [[JP Balmet]] created a concept-art illustration of him on [[May 12]], [[2017]].{{SW|url=star-wars-resistance-the-platform-classic-concept-art-gallery|text="The Platform Classic" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 4}} In "The Platform Classic," the Esral'sa'Nikto was voiced by the actor [[Jonathan Lipow]]. In the audio commentary for the episode, [[Christopher Sean]], the voice actor of Kazuda Xiono, praised Lipow's performance of the language's sounds. Sean also expressed that he liked Oplock as a character and appreciated Speedstar's care for his mechanic. Meanwhile, [[Myrna Velasco]]—the voice actor of [[Ace Squadron]] pilot [[Torra Doza]]—appreciated the humor in Oplock's Cracek outburst, finding the moment "perfect timing." ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *''[[Star Wars Resistance: Le Secret de Yeager]]'' *{{Resistance|The Platform Classic}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/the-platform-classic-episode-guide|text="The Platform Classic" Episode Guide | Star Wars Resistance}} *{{BucketsList|4qPmIGHVfCg|#1.9: "The Platform Classic"|sw_url=video/buckets-list-the-platform-classic-star-wars-resistance}} *{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-the-platform-classic-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 11 Fun Facts from "The Platform Classic" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}} *{{InsiderCite|190|Resistance Revisited|''Resistance'' Revisited|reprint=1}} *{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars Resistance: Complete Season One|episode=The Platform Classic}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|Ace Squadron}} *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|marcus-speedstar|Marcus Speedstar}} {{Imo}} *{{Databank|oplock|Oplock}} *{{Databank|r4-d12|R4-D12}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Oplock|imagecat=Images of Oplock}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Oplock |ja=オプロック |ka=ოპლოკი }} [[Category:Esral'sa'Nikto]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Mechanics]]
